04/27/2023: Station Maintenance:                                         [1330] 
 
            - site maintenance, including: 
               - checked anemometer (bearings good) 
               - checked battery (13.5 V) 
               - checked soil sensor and power cables (good)

               - tested leaf wetness sensor [standard] (good)* 
               - replaced pyranometer 
 
               * site does not include a canopy sensor

04/09/2019: Logger Setup                                                 [1110] 
 
            - Loaded MAWN Program: aet-bssd

                                        s => SDI-12 [HygroVue10] (Temp/RH)
